verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

Round 3 remains correct and complete. The workflow binds label-event authorization to the event sender, independently evaluates author and actor permissions, grants trust only to the exact write+ permission set, and fails closed when either identity or decision input is missing or unreadable. The quarantine decision has one executable definition, restores both boundary labels for unauthorized changes, and permits deliberate unquarantine only for a write+ actor on a label event. The self-test covers the complete trigger/action and independent trust-axis matrix, asymmetric argument-binding cases, fail-closed CLI defaults, exact workflow seams, and the fixed-point/no-empty-mutation properties. I found no correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue. With zero findings in both rounds 2 and 3, progress is stagnant under the required scale.
